scope: Wire durable item attempts into every DATA-02 resumable backfill write phase and bind successful publication attempts to exact four-Publication evidence.
implemented_contract: Quote, valuation, price, financial and final publication phases create per-asset RUNNING attempts before their provider or publication boundary and apply one terminal transition afterward.
Stable run, batch and execution identities derive from the final frozen-universe-bound idempotency key and remain stable across logical task retries.
The first attempt atomically creates the diagnostic FETCHING run and RUNNING batch before external writes; later attempts reuse the task-scoped prepared batch.
Stale RUNNING attempts older than the 3,900-second recovery boundary become INTERRUPTED before the next monotonic attempt is inserted; a recent active attempt blocks overlap.
Any item-attempt begin or finish persistence failure returns blocked, preserves the current offset and writes a non-advancing aggregate checkpoint.
Authority is revalidated at every provider write boundary, once before finalization and again after full-universe publication attempts have been prepared.
Successful publication attempts require a SHA-256 over exactly four unique immutable Publication dataset keys, ids, hashes, equal member counts and the canonical published count.
Migration 0080 adds publication evidence_hash and a database constraint that forbids a succeeded publication attempt without evidence.
If the final run/batch/checkpoint snapshot rolls back, the pre-write FETCHING run, RUNNING batch and terminal item evidence remain available for diagnosis.
The bounded task response still previews at most 20 errors while the item-attempt store retains complete per-asset phase history.

resolved_before_commit: Publication authority is revalidated after potentially long item-attempt setup and before the publication writer is called.
Successful publication attempts now carry a canonical immutable Publication evidence hash and per-asset stored_count=1.
Run and batch existence precede item insertion, and item evidence failure blocks checkpoint advancement.
retained_open_gates: Quote and valuation provider identities are still validated after their current fact mutation; pre-mutation validation or a transaction-wide rollback boundary remains required.
PostgreSQL concurrent begin/recovery/finish evidence is not available in the local SQLite environment.
A 5,533-asset publication-attempt scale run and bulk persistence optimization remain required before production execution.
The publication transaction still needs candidate-bound same-authority compare-and-set evidence under a real PostgreSQL production candidate.
